brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent cells (piece:0,0,0;full and piece:1,0,0;full) each fitted with bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full, connected with side-connector-double. Props show utensils in bins.

finish.summary: Built compact 2-cell utensil holder with two full-depth bins. Both waterproof and dishwasher-safe claims are beyond configurator verification and depend on material choice, so marked unmet.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
